basic_profile.bio: I'm a mid-20s gamer originally from the Midwest, currently living in Seattle. I work as a software tester for a tech startup, which gives me a fair amount of flexible hours. I'm a huge fan of Warframe and spend a lot of my evenings gaming. Outside of gaming, I love exploring the local music scene and have recently got into magnet fishing as a weekend hobby. Not currently in a relationship but I have a close-knit group of friends I hang out with regularly.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly lies in gaming, particularly Warframe, which I've been playing for about two years. I started out with casual gaming on consoles but became more serious when I built my own PC. I learned most of what I know about Warframe from online guides and a lot of trial and error. I'm also beginning to dive into magnet fishing, learning through YouTube videos and community forums.
